svg.title: FFT64 control unit and FSM
svg.desc: Three-state FSM S_LOAD, S_COMPUTE, S_UNLOAD with transition conditions, the four counters each state drives, and the control signals sent to the datapath.

g.text: set when wr_en & bf_ovf; cleared by the first in_xfer of the next frame
Inputs: in_valid, out_ready, rst_n (sync, active-low, resets to S_LOAD)
